cues_target_check.name: cues_target_check
cues_target_check.value: (target_kind IN ('band', 'set') AND target_section IS NULL AND target_tag_id IS NULL) OR (target_kind = 'section' AND target_section IS NOT NULL AND target_tag_id IS NULL) OR (target_kind = 'tag' AND target_tag_id IS NOT NULL AND target_section IS NULL)

cues_length_check.name: cues_length_check
cues_length_check.value: (kind = 'phrase' AND typeof(length) = 'integer' AND length >= 2 AND transition_length IS NULL) OR (kind = 'state' AND length IS NULL AND (transition_length IS NULL OR (typeof(transition_length) = 'integer' AND transition_length >= 1)))

cues_value_check.name: cues_value_check
cues_value_check.value: (value GLOB 'builtin:?*' AND phrase_asset_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'phrase' AND phrase_asset_id IS NOT NULL AND value = 'show:' || phrase_asset_id) OR (channel IN ('carry', 'silk', 'uniform') AND kind = 'state' AND value GLOB 'library:?*@?*' AND phrase_asset_id IS NULL) OR (channel = 'carry' AND kind = 'state' AND value = 'none' AND phrase_asset_id IS NULL)

cues_ripple_json_check.name: cues_ripple_json_check
cues_ripple_json_check.value: ripple_json IS NULL OR (channel <> 'feet' AND json_valid(ripple_json) AND json_type(ripple_json) = 'object' AND json_extract(ripple_json, '$.version') = 1 AND json_type(ripple_json, '$.span') = 'integer' AND json_extract(ripple_json, '$.span') >= 1 AND json_extract(ripple_json, '$.order') IN ('drill', 'left_right', 'right_left', 'down_form'))

item_artwork_slots_slot_check.name: item_artwork_slots_slot_check
item_artwork_slots_slot_check.value: slot IS NOT NULL AND length(slot) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND slot NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*'

item_artwork_slots_library_check.name: item_artwork_slots_library_check
item_artwork_slots_library_check.value: (library_item_id IS NULL AND library_version_hash IS NULL) OR (library_item_id IS NOT NULL AND library_version_hash IS NOT NULL AND length(library_item_id) = 36 AND length(library_version_hash) = 64)

item_artwork_slots_fit_check.name: item_artwork_slots_fit_check
item_artwork_slots_fit_check.value: fit IS NOT NULL AND fit IN ('fill', 'fit')

item_artwork_slots_pan_check.name: item_artwork_slots_pan_check
item_artwork_slots_pan_check.value: pan_x IS NOT NULL AND pan_y IS NOT NULL AND typeof(pan_x) IN ('real', 'integer') AND typeof(pan_y) IN ('real', 'integer') AND pan_x BETWEEN -1 AND 1 AND pan_y BETWEEN -1 AND 1

item_artwork_slots_pad_color_check.name: item_artwork_slots_pad_color_check
item_artwork_slots_pad_color_check.value: pad_color IS NULL OR (length(pad_color) = 7 AND pad_color GLOB '#[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]')

item_geometry_rolls_out_check.name: item_geometry_rolls_out_check
item_geometry_rolls_out_check.value: (rolls_out = 0 AND leading_edge IS NULL) OR (rolls_out = 1 AND leading_edge IS NOT NULL AND leading_edge IN ('front', 'back', 'left', 'right'))

item_placement_marchers_role_check.name: item_placement_marchers_role_check
item_placement_marchers_role_check.value: (role = 'holder' AND hand IS NOT NULL AND hand IN ('left', 'right', 'both')) OR (role = 'crew' AND hand IS NULL)

item_placements_group_check.name: item_placements_group_check
item_placements_group_check.value: (group_id IS NULL AND ripple_json IS NULL) OR (typeof(group_id) = 'integer' AND group_id >= 1 AND ripple_json IS NOT NULL AND json_valid(ripple_json) AND json_type(ripple_json) = 'object' AND json_extract(ripple_json, '$.version') = 1 AND json_type(ripple_json, '$.span') = 'integer' AND json_extract(ripple_json, '$.span') >= 1 AND json_extract(ripple_json, '$.order') IN ('drill', 'left_right', 'right_left', 'down_form'))

items_surface_type_check.name: items_surface_type_check
items_surface_type_check.value: (kind = 'prop' AND surface_type IS NOT NULL AND surface_type IN ('floor', 'platform', 'obstacle')) OR (kind = 'equipment' AND surface_type IS NULL)

items_library_check.name: items_library_check
items_library_check.value: (library_item_id IS NULL AND library_version_hash IS NULL) OR (library_item_id IS NOT NULL AND library_version_hash IS NOT NULL AND length(library_item_id) = 36 AND length(library_version_hash) = 64)

timeline_shapes_circle_check.name: timeline_shapes_circle_check
timeline_shapes_circle_check.value: kind <> 'circle' OR (coalesce(json_type(geometry, '$.radius'), '') IN ('integer', 'real') AND json_extract(geometry, '$.radius') > 0 AND json_extract(geometry, '$.radius') <= 1e6 AND coalesce(json_type(geometry, '$.start_angle'), '') IN ('integer', 'real') AND json_extract(geometry, '$.start_angle') >= 0 AND json_extract(geometry, '$.start_angle') < 6.283185307179586)

timeline_transitions_ftl_shape_check.name: timeline_transitions_ftl_shape_check
timeline_transitions_ftl_shape_check.value: dest_shape_id IS NOT NULL OR path_style <> 'follow_the_leader'

timing_objects.name: timing_objects
timing_objects.definition:
SELECT
        beats.position AS position,
        beats.duration AS duration,
        SUM(duration) OVER (
            ORDER BY position
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS timestamp,
        beats.id AS beat_id,
        pages.id AS page_id,
        measures.id AS measure_id
    FROM beats
    LEFT JOIN pages
        ON beats.id = pages.start_beat
    LEFT JOIN measures
        ON beats.id = measures.start_beat
    ORDER BY beats.position ASC
